trial.title: TIPS Plus Half-dose Donafenib in AHCC with PVTT-associated Portal Hypertension

endpoints.measure: Objective response rate (ORR) by RECIST 1.1 and mRECIST
endpoints.time_frame: From date of first dose of study drug until disease progression, stable disease, development of unacceptable toxicity, withdrawal of consent, or sponsor termination (up to 1 year)
endpoints.description: ORR is defined as the percentage of participants who have best overall response (BOR) of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) at the time of data cutoff as assessed by RECIST 1.1 or mRECIST

endpoints.time_frame: From the start date of the TIPS until date of death from any cause, assessed up to 2 years.
endpoints.description: OS is measured from the start date of the TIPS until date of death from any cause. Participants who are lost to follow-up and the participants who are alive at the date of data cutoff will be censored at the date the participant was last known alive or the cut-off date, whichever comes earlier, assessed up to 2 years.

endpoints.time_frame: The progression-free survival (PFS) defined as the time from the date of TIPS to the date of first documented progression (mRECIST or RECIST v1.1) or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years
endpoints.description: The progression-free survival (PFS) defined as the time from the date of TIPS to the date of first documented progression (mRECIST or RECIST v1.1) or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

endpoints.time_frame: From date of first dose of study drug until disease progression, stable disease, development of unacceptable toxicity, withdrawal of consent, or sponsor termination (up to 1 year)
endpoints.description: DCR is defined as the percentage of participants who have best overall response (BOR) of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) or stable disease (SD) at the time of data cutoff as assessed by RECIST 1.1 or mRECIST.

endpoints.measure: Rate of portosystemic shunt stent patency
endpoints.description: The status of the shunt stent evaluated by the color Doppler ultrasound.

endpoints.measure: Recurrence rate of portal hypertension-related complications
endpoints.time_frame: From date of TIPS until portal hypertension-related complications (up to 6 months)
endpoints.description: It was defined as the percentage of patients with recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding, refractory ascites, hepatic pleural effusion, and portal hypertensive gastroenteropathy within 6 months after TIPS

outcome.rationale: Novel combination of TIPS plus half-dose donafenib in high-risk PVTT population lacks direct evidence. Primary ORR likely modest (~18%); survival benefit uncertain given half-dose and disease severity. Safety profile acceptable but efficacy concerns. Single-arm phase II design limits definitive conclusions.

value.estimand: Single-arm, BCLC-C HCC with PVTT and portal hypertension, treated with TIPS + half-dose donafenib, assessed by RECIST 1.1 or mRECIST, up to 1 year
value.uncertainty: Half-dose donafenib may reduce efficacy vs full dose; TIPS may improve liver function but tumor thrombus progression risk; single-arm design; indirect evidence from donafenib+sintilimab study (ORR 16.7-23.3%)
value.rationale: Based on donafenib+sintilimab phase II showing ORR 16.7-23.3% at full dose, half-dose donafenib (100mg BID) expected to yield modestly lower ORR ~18%. TIPS may improve drug delivery by reducing portal hypertension but PVTT remains poor prognostic factor. Wide CI reflects dose uncertainty and population severity.

value.uncertainty: TIPS alone in PVTT shows mOS ~6 months; donafenib+sintilimab shows mOS 16 months in less advanced population; combination effect uncertain; half-dose may compromise survival benefit; high-risk population with symptomatic portal hypertension
value.rationale: TIPS+FCS in PVTT-associated SPH: mOS 6.0 months. Donafenib+sintilimab in BCLC-C: mOS 16.0 months. Combination expected to exceed TIPS alone but half-dose and severe portal hypertension limit extrapolation. Predicted mOS ~9 months (midpoint between TIPS-alone and systemic therapy benchmarks, adjusted for severity).

value.effect_measure: Recurrence rate of portal hypertension-related complications
value.estimand: Single-arm, percentage with recurrent GI bleeding, refractory ascites, hepatic pleural effusion, or portal hypertensive gastroenteropathy within 6 months post-TIPS
value.uncertainty: TIPS effectively reduces portal pressure but PVTT progression can negate benefit; tumor thrombus may extend into shunt; underlying liver function (Child-Pugh up to 13) limits durability
value.rationale: TIPS controls acute variceal bleeding and ascites in ~80-90% of cirrhotic patients. However PVTT-associated SPH has higher recurrence due to thrombus progression and shunt dysfunction. Predicted 6-month recurrence ~35% balancing TIPS efficacy against PVTT severity and advanced liver disease.

analysis_trace.trial_identification: NCT06646198: DoTH Study - Phase II single-arm trial of TIPS plus half-dose donafenib (100mg BID) in advanced HCC with PVTT-associated portal hypertension
analysis_trace.indication: Advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (BCLC-C) with portal vein tumor thrombus (PVTT) and portal hypertension-related complications
analysis_trace.patient_population: 40 patients, BCLC-C stage, ECOG 0-1, Child-Pugh ≤13, newly diagnosed, no prior systemic therapy, with symptomatic portal hypertension
analysis_trace.target_mechanism: TIPS relieves portal hypertension; donafenib (deuterated sorafenib) provides anti-angiogenic/anti-tumor effects at reduced dose (100mg BID vs standard 200mg BID)
analysis_trace.endpoint_interpretation: Primary ORR by RECIST 1.1/mRECIST; Secondary OS, PFS, DCR, shunt patency, and portal hypertension complication recurrence
analysis_trace.safety_analysis: Half-dose donafenib expected to reduce AEs vs full dose; TIPS-related risks include hepatic encephalopathy, shunt dysfunction
analysis_trace.key_risks: High-risk population with PVTT and portal hypertension; TIPS may accelerate liver failure; tumor thrombus progression may occlude shunt; reduced donafenib dose may compromise anti-tumor efficacy
analysis_trace.evidence_to_prediction: Donafenib+sintilimab phase II (NCT05162352): ORR 16.7-23.3%, mPFS 6.2-6.3mo, mOS 16.0mo. TIPS+FCS in HCC+PVTT: mOS 6.0mo. TIPS+systemic therapy studies show feasibility. Half-dose donafenib extrapolated from safety run-in data showing 50% DLT at 200mg BID requiring dose reduction
analysis_trace.coverage_gaps: No direct data on half-dose donafenib efficacy; no published TIPS+donafenib combination studies; PVTT-specific outcomes limited; single-arm design without comparator
